sentences.text:
2. The applicant is seeking quashment of crime registered on the basis of the F.I.R. lodged by the
respondent bearing Crime No. 158/2020, registered with Wadhvan Police Station Tq. Udgir, Dist.
Latur for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of the
Indian Penal Code.
Her learned advocate tenders across the Bar an affidavit in reply.
She has specifically mentioned that the matrimonial dispute has been sorted out amicably between her and her husband.
Her learned advocate submits that she is consenting for quashing of the crime albeit it is erroneously mentioned in the affidavit requesting to dispose of the application.

Considering the nature of the dispute and the settlement arrived at between the couple, we allow the application and quash and set aside the Crime No. 158/2020, registered with Wadhvan Police Station Tq. Udgir, Dist.
